definitions.rating_std: population standard deviation of historical ratings
definitions.log_activity_span_days: log(1 + days between first and last rating)
definitions.genre_*: sum of fractional genre allocations / user rating count

preprocessing: StandardScaler on descriptive user features; zero genre exposure means no observed rated movies of that genre
excluded: tags/genome not present in current rating warehouse
timing_scope: full history is valid for descriptive clustering; these summaries are not H3 predictive features
